clock.source: DS Rev1.2 EN: 32 MHz max; RM v1.2 RCC/FLASH chapters (same layout as PY32F030)
clock.trim_addr_source: inferred: same addresses as PY32F030 RM; verify on hardware

name: PY32F003
notes: DS Rev1.9 has no real Port B alternate-function table (the section repeats Port A). PB5-PB7 follow DS Rev1.2 EN; PB0-PB4 and PB8 use the numbering of the PY32F030 DS Rev2.2 table (marked source=inferred); their function set matches the F003 pin table.
DS Rev1.9 alternate-function table lists SPI2_* and LED_* (copied from PY32F030); the chip has only SPI1 and no LED controller (DS Rev1.2 EN, RM, SVD), those entries are dropped.
TSSOP20 F4 (Pinout4) has the dual-bonded pad PA2/PF2-NRST on pin 2.

danger.NRST_MODE: 1 makes PF2 a GPIO: no hardware reset pin
danger.RDP: any value except 0xAA turns on read-out protection; going back to 0xAA mass-erases the chip
danger.SDK: SDK area is not readable by the debugger

rdp.note: 0xAA = level 0 (open); any other value = level 1 (read-out protected)

option_bytes.source: RM v1.2 4.4 (production values from the RM; field layout verified against the PY32F030 RM, same text)

PA1.af_source: DS Rev1.9 p25-26 (row split by a page break; identical to the PY32F030 row)

PB5.af_source: DS Rev1.2 EN table 4-4 (matches PY32F030 numbering)

PB6.af_source: DS Rev1.2 EN table 4-4 (matches PY32F030 numbering)
